items.label: Official application form
items.rule: Distributed through the sending agency; each applicant is allowed one application form.

items.label: Passport copy / scan
items.rule: Identity must match application; width 600 px; ≤100 KB; passport valid at least 3 months from application date.

items.label: Recent passport photo file
items.rule: 3.5×4.5 cm; white background; within 6 months; JPG ≤15 KB; 100–300 px.

items.label: Application fee payment slip
items.rule: Current fee US$28 / LKR 9,250 under the official notice.
